title: Google Family Link Usage Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Canvas assignments (`canvas:assignment`), Khan Academy SAT practice (`khan:sat`), Family Link usage (`familylink:usage`), and OurHome chores (`ourhome:chore`).
app: Canvas LMS exports, Khan Academy SAT practice, Google Family Link screen-time data, and OurHome chore tracking streamed to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=familylink:usage
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(app_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Google Family Link usage events land each day and how many distinct app name values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Google Family Link usage records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct app name values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how much Google Family Link usage activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
